title: TagFilterMap
description: Keeps only the approved tags (`includeTags`) on the target work item, always drops the blocked ones (`excludeTags`), and logs each tag it drops.

ApplyTo.description: A list of Work Item Types that this Field Map will apply to. Use "*" to apply it to all Work Item Types. A field map with an empty list applies to no Work Item Types and never runs.

Enabled.description: Not used: every configured field map runs for the work item types in `ApplyTo`. To turn a field map off, remove it from `FieldMaps`.

excludeTags.description: The blocked tags. A tag that matches one of them is always dropped, even when it also matches `includeTags`.

includeTags.description: The approved tags. When it has entries, only tags that match one of them are kept. When it is empty, every tag is kept unless it matches `excludeTags`.
